body.para: Specifies whether the DBFCDX RDD reads its index files in strict mode (STRICTREAD ON) or allows "dirty reads" (DIRTYREAD ON), where index data is read without taking the locks that guarantee a consistent state.

SET STRICTREAD ON | OFF | &<cMacro>
SET DIRTYREAD ON | OFF | &<cMacro>

ON | OFFFor SET STRICTREAD, ON enables the strict mode. For SET DIRTYREAD the meaning is reversed: ON allows dirty reads, which is the same as SET STRICTREAD OFF. The value may also be a macro (&) that evaluates to ON or OFF.
Both commands change the same runtime setting. SET DIRTYREAD ON is equivalent to SET STRICTREAD OFF and SET DIRTYREAD OFF is equivalent to SET STRICTREAD ON.
